# Finding template

Copy this structure into the appropriate notes category after investigating a
real question. Replace the prompts, use a descriptive title and filename, and
remove sections that do not help explain the finding.

## Claim

State one specific conclusion in a sentence below the note's title. Mark it
WORKING if an assumption remains unsettled.

## Origin

Record the triggering question, primary references, observation date, and
relevant versions or configuration. Say whether the claim comes from documented
behavior, source inspection, a static check, or observed execution.

## What and why

Explain the mechanism, unfamiliar syntax, why it is useful, and the tradeoff
against plausible alternatives. State the conditions under which it applies.

## Example

Show a small example with the appropriate Runnable, Excerpt, Conceptual, or
Compile-fail label. For a complete program, include its execution command and
observed outcome. For an excerpt, link its source and explain the omitted context.

## Gotchas

Describe the failure modes and limits that matter to a caller. Keep compiler,
runtime, framework, and application guarantees distinct.

## Used in

Describe the kind of use this finding supports. Keep reusable notes independent
of checkout paths; the corresponding module walkthrough links the actual usage.

## Related

Link existing explanations that deepen or qualify the claim. Do not create
empty companion notes just to fill this section.

## Open question

If the claim is WORKING, name the remaining uncertainty and the next observation
or experiment that would settle it.
